answer.reason: Besides marking the border, the verses tell that the LORD gave Ar to the children of Lot and that it was laid waste.

clauses.english: was given by the LORD to the children of Lot as a possession
clauses.quote: I have given Ar unto the children of Lot for a possession

clauses.english: was laid waste and brought to silence in the night
clauses.quote: in the night Ar of Moab is laid waste

doubts: NUM 21:28 says fire from Heshbon consumed Ar of Moab, but it is in a song and I left it out as the same ruin as ISA 15:1.
NUM 21:15, DEU 2:18 and DEU 2:29 only mark the border or a stage of the journey, so I did not use them.
In DEU 2:9 Ar may mean the land of Moab rather than the city.
